newsitem.title: USA: Minntech to drop dialyzers, take a charge.
newsitem.headline: Minntech to drop dialyzers, take a charge.

text.p: Minntech Corp said Monday it will take one-time charge of between $5 million and $7 million in the fourth quarter ended March 31 to cover its planned exit from the dialyzer business.
The move will result in a loss for the fiscal year of between $1.5 million and $3.5 million, Minntech said.

The medical device manufacturer said the highly competitive dialyzer business, which included its Primus dialyzer and Cathetron catheter reprocessing system, had been a drain on its financial resources.
Without the one-time charge, Minntech said its earnings for the fourth quarter would have been close to its previous expectations.
The company is expected to report full results for the fourth quarter and fiscal 1997 in May.
Minntech shares were up 1/8 Monday at 10-3/8.
